final: WITH c AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), v AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM c) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM v ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
